_readme.what: A local stand-in for Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol agent registry. lib/tap/registry.ts reads this and nothing else.
_readme.real_tap: Real TAP resolves a keyId over the network against Visa's registry, and a merchant that does not recognise an agent refuses it. We are not building that. This file is the same lookup, committed, so the merchant side of our demo can do a genuine key resolution rather than skipping the step.
_readme.shape: keys[<keyId>] = { agentId, agentName, publicKeyPem, registeredAt }. publicKeyPem is an SPKI PEM with newlines escaped as \n, the same form the environment variables use.
_readme.adding_yours: Run `npm run keys:tap`. It prints the four .env.local lines and the JSON entry to paste in here. The keyId in this file must match TAP_KEY_ID in .env.local or every signature fails as unknown-key.
_readme.the_seed_entry: vra-key-25ac is a PLACEHOLDER. Its private key was printed once and never saved, so nothing can sign as it — it is here to document the shape, not to be used. Replace it with your own.
_readme.secrets: Public keys only. A private key must never appear in this file.
